_comment: API Contract for KPI Detail Page — share with backend team.
_uiComponents: EnhancedKPICard  (title, subtitle, status, metrics row, trend chart with history + forecast)
Agent Recommendations grid (priority, impact, tags, improvement, timeline, cost, implemented)
RelatedKPIsGrid  (SCOR-stage linked KPIs at the bottom)

endpoint.description: Returns all data required to render the KPI Detail page for a given KPI and module.

kpiId.description: Snake-case KPI identifier, e.g. 'otif', 'stockHealth', 'expiryRisk'. Same ID used in /api/kpi/all.

module.description: Active module context. Filters content (root causes, recommendations, related KPIs) to be relevant for the chosen module.

timePeriod.description: Granularity of trendData.history and trendData.forecast returned. UI has Daily / Monthly / Yearly tabs.

data.name: Internal OTIF
data.title: Internal OTIF
data.subtitle: On-Time, In-Full Delivery
data._sectionComment_metrics: ─── SECTION 2: Metrics row in EnhancedKPICard (GOAL | YTD | BASELINE | L QTR | CURRENT) ───
data.formula: ((Orders Delivered On Time AND In Full) ÷ Total Internal Orders) × 100
data._sectionComment_chart: ─── SECTION 3: Trend chart in EnhancedKPICard (history + AI forecast overlay) ───
data._sectionComment_rootCauses: ─── SECTION 4: Root Cause Analysis panel (RootCausePanel). Groups causes by category. severity: high|medium|low, impact is % contribution. ───

causes.name: Forecast Inaccuracy
causes.description: WAPE >15% for critical SKUs causing demand misalignment

causes.name: Lead Time Variability
causes.description: High variance in supplier delivery times

data._sectionComment_recommendations: ─── SECTION 5: Agent Recommendations grid. priority: CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW, impact: high|medium|low, implemented defaults false. ───

recommendations.title: Increase Safety Stock for Life-saving Medicines
recommendations.description: Prioritize safety stock buffers for ICU/critical-use items in OT to reduce stockout-driven delays.

recommendations.title: Optimize Reorder Points for Fast-moving Items
recommendations.description: Recalibrate reorder points using recent consumption and lead times to prevent frequent replenishment gaps.

recommendations.title: Review Restricted Medicine Access Controls
recommendations.description: Reduce approval bottlenecks by streamlining access control workflows for restricted items while maintaining compliance.

recommendations.title: Implement FEFO for Expiry Management
recommendations.description: Apply First-Expired-First-Out (FEFO) picking and redistribution to minimize expiry-related waste and fulfillment disruptions.

data._sectionComment_relatedKPIs: ─── SECTION 6: Related KPIs grid (RelatedKPIsGrid) at the bottom. stage maps to SCOR stages: Plan|Source|Make|Deliver|Return|Enable. icon is lucide-react icon name. ───

relatedKPIs.name: Inbound Supplier OTIF
relatedKPIs.formula: Inbound OTIF = (POs On-Time AND In-Full) / Total POs × 100

relatedKPIs.name: First Pass Yield (FPY)
relatedKPIs.formula: FPY = (Units accepted with no rework) / Units started × 100

relatedKPIs.name: Customer OTIF
relatedKPIs.formula: Customer OTIF = (Orders On-Time AND In-Full) / Total Orders × 100

relatedKPIs.name: Return Resolution Lead Time
relatedKPIs.formula: RLT = Median(Return Closed Date - Return Initiated Date)

relatedKPIs.name: Exception-to-Recovery Time
relatedKPIs.formula: E2R = Median(Recovery Time - Exception Detected Time)

fieldReference._comment: Complete field-by-field description of every key in data{}.
fieldReference.id: string — unique KPI identifier, matches the key in /api/kpi/all
fieldReference.name: string — display name shown in the page header
fieldReference.title: string — card heading inside EnhancedKPICard (usually same as name)
fieldReference.subtitle: string — one-line descriptor shown below the title
fieldReference.description: string — short text shown under the page H1 title
fieldReference.module: string — echoes back the requested module
fieldReference.timePeriod: string — echoes back the requested timePeriod (daily|monthly|yearly)
fieldReference.unit: string — '%', 'RM', 'days', 'hours', etc. Applied throughout the UI
fieldReference.status: string — 'healthy' | 'warning' | 'critical'. Controls card border colour and status badge.
fieldReference.target: number — Goal / target value. Shown in GOAL and L QTR columns and as the dashed reference line on the chart.
fieldReference.current: number — Latest actual value. Shown in CURRENT and YTD columns.
fieldReference.ytd: number — Year-to-date value (can equal current if not separately tracked).
fieldReference.baseline: number — Starting-of-period reference value, shown in BASELINE column. If null, UI uses trendData.history[0].value.
fieldReference.lastQuarter: number — Previous quarter value. Shown in L QTR column. If null, UI falls back to target.
fieldReference.trend: string — Human-readable change string, e.g. '+2.3%', '-1.2%'. Shown next to the current value.
fieldReference.trendValue: number — Numeric change. Positive = TrendingUp arrow, negative = TrendingDown arrow.
fieldReference.gap: number — Difference between target and current (absolute). Shown in KPIDetailCard gap box.
fieldReference.overstock: number | null — Overstock percentage shown only for stockHealth KPI. Send null for all others.
fieldReference.formula: string — Calculation formula shown in the expandable formula tooltip.

trendData.history: array<{date:string, value:number}> — Historical data points. Dates as YYYY-MM-DD. Volume depends on timePeriod: ~8 daily, ~12 monthly, ~5 yearly.

forecast.model: string — Model name for informational purposes ('holt', 'arima', etc.).
forecast.dates: array<string> — ISO date strings for forecast points. First 'overlapPoints' dates must overlap with the last dates of history.
forecast.values: array<number> — Forecast values, same order as dates.
forecast.overlapPoints: integer — How many of the forecast dates also appear in history (used for chart rendering).
forecast.futurePoints: integer — Number of purely future forecast points.

fieldReference.rootCauses: array<category> — Each category has a string 'category' label and 'causes' array. Each cause: {id, name, severity, impact (0-100 %), description}.
fieldReference.recommendations: array — Each item: {id, priority (CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW), impact (high|medium|low), title, description, tags[], improvement (string), timeline (string), cost (string), implemented (boolean)}.
fieldReference.relatedKPIs: array — SCOR-stage related KPIs shown at the bottom. Each: {id, stage (Plan|Source|Make|Deliver|Return|Enable), name, description, value, unit, target, status, formula, icon (lucide-react name), color (hex)}.

moduleAdaptation._comment: The same endpoint must serve all modules. The backend should filter/replace rootCauses, recommendations, and relatedKPIs arrays based on the 'module' query param. The core KPI metrics (current, target, trendData, etc.) are always KPI-specific. Example: for module=staff-allocation, the rootCauses should reference staffing gaps not supplier delays. The relatedKPIs should surface staffing-related SCOR-equivalent KPIs relevant to that module.
